plan_length_note: plan_length_m is the horizontal length of that OSM way, WGS84 haversine with radius 6378137 m, rounded to one decimal. Extract ways match the live OpenStreetMap node counts on 14 October 2026, so those stored polylines are the complete ways. Ways 43402325, 43531503, 43402275, 43531474, 153725899, and 132571388 were read live the same day; they are not in the extract. An approach plan_length_m is still not the climb to grade. The mapped centrelines are not the inspection span totals. They were not averaged.
dropped_note: The four extract road decks (Henday NB and SB, the NW ramp, the SE ramp) are kept. Six more bridge=yes motorway_link decks at this interchange were added from the live read so the folder has the ten major bridges in Alberta file 85047. Extract Henday approaches and the four ramps that share a node with the extract decks are kept. Yellowhead through-ways 60064623, 256516539, 279472325, and 313692014 pass under the Henday decks and continue toward Y64 and the city; they were dropped so the clip stays on this interchange. Closed man_made=bridge ways are footprints of decks already stored as centrelines. Golf cart paths 1309172199 and 1309185329 are Lewis Estates, not this interchange. Alberta sign and pole structures under file 85047 (ZN2, ZS3, ZW4 and the others) are not decks. The 1998 N-1 deck is the one existing bridge; the other nine are 2011. H38, H36, H37, H41, Y64, and A111 are different codes.

dimensions.structural_type: Ten separate grade-separation decks at the west Henday / Yellowhead combination interchange. N-1 (1998) and S-6, NW-7, SE-8, WS1-9, WS3-11, EN1-12 (2011) are Alberta WG girders. WS2-10, EN2-13, and EN3-14 are NU girders. The flyovers that read from the air are WS2-10 and EN2-13 over Henday. Ramps can be the shared girder. Not a truss. Not a single girder line for the whole interchange. Wikipedia: the directional ramps were built one lane wide initially; the decks are wide enough for a second lane.
